text:
jordan: Heads up — we need EBS + GCS quota bumps for a large training run next Tuesday. Main ask: gp3 IOPS pool increase, snapshot concurrency bump, and raise GCS upload/request throughput for our model-checkpoints bucket. Timing: start 2026-04-07, 48h window for bulk snapshot + cross-region copy.

sasha: Which regions and rough numbers? also how many GPUs/instances will attach volumes at once?

jordan: eu-west-1 primary, ap-southeast-1 replica. We'll have ~120 GPU instances (p4d-equivalent) running, each mounts 1-2 gp3 volumes for shard checkpoints. Want account-level gp3 IOPS quota increased from ~50k -> 200k in eu-west-1 for the 48h window. Snapshot concurrency currently 10, need increase to 60 for parallel snapshot+copy jobs. GCS: increase per-bucket request throughput (json API) from 200 qps -> 1200 qps for bucket `redwood-model-checkpoints` during the run to avoid throttling.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: `bulk-snapshot-2026-04-07` (48h) — owners: jordan, marta.

marta: please add cost-center and confirm owner for billing approval. also include a rollback plan. :eyes:

jordan: cost-center: infra-research, owner: jordan. rollback plan: pause snapshots, fall back to sequential copies at lower concurrency, and use reduced batch size for restarts.

cloud-ops: OK, we can file the AWS support case and GCP support request. I need the exact language to copy into tickets. Can someone paste a canned request?

jordan: copying proposed request below (paste directly to AWS Support/GCP console):

```
Subject: Request: Temporary account quota increases for bulk checkpointing (gp3 IOPS, snapshot concurrency)
Description:
We plan a bulk checkpointing window for model training in eu-west-1 starting 2026-04-07 for ~48 hours. Request the following temporary quota increases for account 123456789012 (Redwood - eu-west-1):
- EBS (gp3) total IOPS quota: increase from 50,000 -> 200,000 for duration 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC to 2026-04-09 00:00 UTC.
- EBS Snapshot Create/Copy concurrency: increase from 10 -> 60 for same duration to support parallel snapshots and cross-region copies.
- If available, increase EBS snapshot API throughput for cross-region copy operations during the window.
Impact: without these increases, snapshot jobs will queue and training recovery time will exceed SLOs. We will revert quotas after the window. Contact: jordan@redwood.example.com, phone: +1-555-0100.
```

And GCP request: 
```
Subject: Increase GCS request throughput for bucket `redwood-model-checkpoints`
Description: Temporary increase of JSON API request rate from 200 qps -> 1200 qps for bucket `redwood-model-checkpoints` in project `redwood-infra` from 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC to 2026-04-09 00:00 UTC to support parallel uploads and copies for model checkpointing. Contact: jordan@redwood.example.com
```

sasha: Looks good. Please include these details in internal tracker (link) and tag `#cost-ops` for approval. Also add the expected bytes transferred — helps support prioritize.

jordan: estimated cross-region transfer ~18 TB over 48h (~4 MB/s sustained per copy with up to 50 concurrent copies).

devon: tagging billing and security: @marta please confirm there are no compliance blocks on cross-region copies for these checkpoints.

marta: confirmed — no PII, model weights only. Approved from compliance side. Adding :white_check_mark:.

cloud-ops: I'll open the cases now. Filing with AWS support + GCP support, request expedited review and include the infra-runbook. Will post case numbers here. :rocket:

infra-bot: AWS case created: case-id AWS-20260407-001 (priority: high). GCP case created: GCP-20260407-021 (priority: high).

jordan: thanks — once cases are in, I'll schedule the snapshot coordinator jobs and post playbook. Please keep monitoring network egress and account IOPS metrics.

cloud-ops: will watch. tagging `#eng-oncall` for extra eyes during the window.

devon: :thumbsup:
